_about: Seasonal festival calendar (List 11 #105). Festivals are window-keyed world events riding #19's world clock (the calendar layer above phase) under the NO-PRESSURE LAW inherited from #56: windows say WHEN, never HURRY; everything recurs (a festival record has no year field and no one-time flag, by construction); festival goods are cosmetic/record/care-class — never power, never story progress, never a species' only availability window. ZERO festivals are instanced and the calendar's own shape (day kinds, season names) is OPEN — inherited from #93's open day-kinds slot, not filled here.

beats.activity: hosted, never invented: a #56 minigame loop | #78 showcase exhibition | #97 research demonstration
beats.announce: #90 Iridescence media channel block (display-layer names only, #90 Leak discipline)
beats.close: closing beat writes an attendance fact (vars.* tally shape) — the tally buys nothing
beats.gather: #93 schedule OVERRIDES for named NPCs during the window (ambient population stays LIVING-WORLD's layer)

festival_shape.window: cyclic predicate over { season (vocabulary OPEN), phase (#19 dawn|day|dusk|night) } — no year, no one-shot date

forest_rule: PROPOSED standing rule (owner confirmation): the Dark Forest takes no festivals — its state is #19's dread cycle, advanced by depth and script, never by the clock; a DEPTHS festival is excluded by #33's withholding discipline ('no Forest eyecatch, ever'). A festival at the Forest's edge (the Gate is not the Forest) is a script decision.
open_register: calendar shape: day kinds, season names, year form
every festival: name, window, place, activity
attendance tally fields beyond the shape
